subject: general
question: Ustad Ghagge Khuda Baksh was associated with which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Ghagge Khuda Baksh** was a renowned figure associated with the **Agra gharana**.
 
• The **Agra gharana** is one of the oldest and most prominent gharanas in Hindustani classical music.
 
• This gharana is known for its unique style of singing called **‘Dhrupad’** and later also adopted the **Khayal** style.
 
• The founders of the Agra gharana were **Haji Sujan Khan** and **Ustad Ghagge Khuda Baksh**.
 
• Agra gharana emphasizes on maintaining the purity of the ragas and is known for its deep and forceful singing.
 
• This gharana has produced many prominent musicians including **Ustad Faiyaz Khan** and **Ustad Vilayat Hussain Khan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi gharana**__

 __
 
• The **Delhi gharana** is one of the oldest gharanas of Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is known for its unique style of **Tabla playing**.
 
• The founders of this gharana were **Ustad Siddhar Khan Dhadi**.
 
 
 
• **Benaras gharana**__
 __
 
• The **Benaras gharana** is famous for its style of **Tabla playing** and **Thumri singing**.
 
• It was established by **Pt. Ram Sahai** in the 18th century.
 
• The gharana is named after the city of **Varanasi (Benaras)**.
 
 
 
• **Gwalior gharana**__
 
 
• The **Gwalior gharana** is the oldest Khayal gharana in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It was founded by **Ustad Nathan Pir Bakhsh** in the 19th century.
 
• The gharana is known for its emphasis on **clarity of notes** and a systematic development of the **Raga**.
